name: Jane Chao
bio:
Jane is making coding accessible and engaging for Swift developers, with over 9,000 subscribers on her growing YouTube channel 🎬 ChaoCode.

She’s currently building Simple LLM, a macOS chatbot designed for iOS enthusiasts, integrating OpenAI and open-source models with advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation for smarter responses 🤯.

A fan of SwiftUI and experienced in backend development on Google Cloud Platform, Jane’s bilingual tutorials in Chinese are inspiring a new generation of coders to dive into iOS development and tech 💻.
